 Order

The petitioners, vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, seek quashing of FIR No.0238/2023 dated 15.04.2023 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S Jagatpuri, Delhi and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners seeks, and is granted, two weeks for filing the Talaqnama.
